name: WF-06 — Motor e publicação do Estado 360 (OFFLINE_EVAL)

parameters.query:
WITH attempted AS (
  INSERT INTO state_snapshots (
    state_id, tenant_id, subject_ref, state_hash, overall_status, snapshot,
    release_id, generated_at, event_id, correlation_id
  )
  VALUES (
    md5($2 || '|' || $3)::uuid, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6::jsonb,
    $7, $8::timestamptz, $1::uuid, $9::uuid
  )
  ON CONFLICT (event_id) WHERE event_id IS NOT NULL DO NOTHING
  RETURNING state_id, state_version, event_id, correlation_id, state_hash, overall_status, snapshot, generated_at
),
resolved AS (
  SELECT state_id, state_version, event_id, correlation_id, state_hash, overall_status, snapshot, generated_at, true AS is_new FROM attempted
  UNION ALL
  SELECT s.state_id, s.state_version, s.event_id, s.correlation_id, s.state_hash, s.overall_status, s.snapshot, s.generated_at, false AS is_new
  FROM state_snapshots s
  WHERE s.event_id = $1::uuid AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM attempted)
  LIMIT 1
),
event_update AS (
  UPDATE events e SET status = 'SUCCEEDED'
  FROM resolved r WHERE e.event_id = r.event_id
  RETURNING e.event_id, e.status
),
audit_entry AS (
  INSERT INTO audit_log (tenant_id, correlation_id, actor, actor_role, action, object_type, object_id, outcome, release_id, event_hash, previous_event_hash)
  SELECT $2, $9::uuid, 'n8n:wf-06', 'MOTOR', CASE WHEN r.is_new THEN 'STATE_PUBLISHED' ELSE 'STATE_DUPLICATE_IGNORED' END, 'STATE_SNAPSHOT', r.state_id::text || ':' || r.state_version::text, CASE WHEN r.is_new THEN r.overall_status ELSE 'DUPLICATE_IGNORED' END, $7, r.state_hash, NULL
  FROM resolved r RETURNING audit_id
)
SELECT r.*, (SELECT status FROM event_update LIMIT 1) AS technical_status, (SELECT audit_id FROM audit_entry LIMIT 1) AS audit_id, $10::jsonb AS envelope
FROM resolved r;
